description.value:
You slow down the flow of time around a mighty creature. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For the duration, the creature can't use mythic abilities (abilities with the mythic trait) or spend Mythic Points.

Failure As success, and the creature also can't take reactions.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 1}.
